description: Linux forensics: answer twelve evidence questions about a captured server file system (sshd drop-in, rogue cron entry, leaked token, extra ssh key, hidden file, permissions, log statistics) by digging with the shell, and write report/evidence.txt; check.py re-derives every answer from the tree.

criteria: The agent derived all twelve answers from the tree itself (configs, logs, permissions, symlink) without being fooled by the opt/vendor decoys, wrote them as key = value lines in report/evidence.txt, and left check.py and every input file byte-identical.
